data.notes: The report gets the core of the deal right. It shows we won the technical evaluation and lost the decider. It ties Halima's "a queue with a faster timer" line to rewriting M5. Its four messaging changes match all four of the key's directions, and it labels "over-promised" as opinion. The header scores 0 because the report does not name Checkout.com or the in-house bank gateway. Neither name appears in the transcript, so the report was right not to invent them; this looks like a gap between the key and the transcript rather than a report error. The close misses two things. It omits commercial terms and the follow-up with the support team on named on-sale coverage. It also mislabels the rep's "why didn't you build it" answer as dodged, when he did answer: "I thought the load test had won it."
